title_zh: 约好参加初学者也能加入的合作游戏晚会

scenario.label_zh: 约好参加初学者也能加入的合作游戏晚会
scenario.goal_zh: 消除初学者对表现的担忧，约定先试玩简单合作游戏并确认到场时间

context_zh: 朋友邀请不熟悉电子游戏的同事参加周五游戏晚会。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Would you like to join our gaming evening on Friday? The rest of the gang will be there.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: I am fond of puzzles, but I am hopeless with a controller. I do not want to make a fool of myself.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: We are playing a cooperative puzzle game, not a tournament. We can learn the controls together.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Not at all. We will start with a practice round, and nobody will keep a score.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: That sounds much better. What time should I come?

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Seven. Come a little early if you want to try the controller before the others arrive.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: I will be there at quarter to seven. Thanks for making it easy to join.

targets.sense_zh: 经常一起活动的一群朋友
傻瓜；此处指做出令人难堪举动的人
